scope: Public-source recheck for independent real-station full-loop validation candidates.

source.title: Hydrogen Station Performance Evaluation (Final Report)
source.publisher: Gas Technology Institute / U.S. DOE EERE
source.reported_scope: Custom data-acquisition systems deployed at five California hydrogen fueling stations with monitoring over approximately four years.
reported_measurements: fueling event fields including fill class, starting vehicle pressure and temperature, ending vehicle pressure and mass dispensed
source.data_access_statement: The report describes the collected data and station instrumentation but exposes no downloadable station logger export, data dictionary, calibration package, or reuse license for raw traces.

eligibility.vehicle_or_receptacle_pressure: reported as a collected field but no raw array public
eligibility.mass_flow_or_transferred_mass: reported as a collected field but no raw array public
eligibility.common_time_base: described for the custom acquisition campaign but not publicly downloadable
eligibility.initial_conditions: partially described; raw metadata not public
eligibility.protocol_metadata: partially described; raw protocol/version records not public
eligibility.reuse_terms: not supplied for a raw logger release

next_action: Request a de-identified station-by-fill export with timestamps, vehicle/receptacle pressure and temperature, mass flow or transferred mass, storage/cascade states, protocol mode, quality/calibration metadata, aborted-fill labels and permission to publish derived metrics. Freeze hashes and the evaluation protocol before inspecting outcomes.
claim_boundary: This report strengthens provenance and the controlled-access data request. It cannot support a numerical full-loop validation claim from the public PDF alone.
